nodes.name: Orchestrator
nodes.description: Central hub that registers agents, routes A2A tasks, runs workflows and serves the monitoring dashboard.

orchestrator-api-key.description: Control/webhook endpoints require an X-API-Key header and fail closed (HTTP 503) when unset.

config.name: Orchestrator API Key
config.description: Requests to control/webhook endpoints must carry a valid X-API-Key header.

dashboard-jwt.description: Monitoring dashboard endpoints require a signed JWT; tokens are rejected when the signing secret is unset.

config.name: Dashboard JWT
config.description: Dashboard API access requires a valid JWT signed with DASHBOARD_JWT_SECRET.

nodes.name: Qdrant Vector Database

nodes.name: Jira MCP Server
nodes.description: Model Context Protocol server bridging agents and Jira.

nodes.name: Google Cloud Run
nodes.description: Managed runtime hosting the orchestrator, agents and supporting services.

nodes.name: Jira
nodes.description: External issue tracker; source of requirements and webhooks, target for incidents.

nodes.name: Zephyr
nodes.description: External test management system receiving test results.

nodes.name: LLM Provider
nodes.description: Large-language-model provider used by the orchestrator and agents: Google Gemini by default, or a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible deployment (Qwen on Cloud Run, authenticated with an IAM identity token).

nodes.name: Test Execution Agents
nodes.description: External UI and API test execution agents that run test cases and expose an A2A endpoint guarded by a shared bearer token.

relationships.description: Orchestrator routes tasks to specialised agents over the A2A protocol.
Orchestrator routes test-execution tasks to the external UI/API execution agents over the A2A protocol.

execution-agent-bearer-token.description: When REMOTE_EXECUTION_AGENT_AUTH_TOKEN is set, the orchestrator presents it as an Authorization: Bearer token on the agents' guarded main A2A endpoint; the agents reject mismatching or missing tokens with HTTP 401.

config.name: Execution Agent Bearer Token
config.description: Calls to the execution agents' main A2A endpoint are authenticated with a shared bearer token.

relationships.description: Jira (or a CI/CD system) calls the orchestrator webhook endpoints to start workflows.

jira-webhook-hmac.description: Webhook requests must carry a valid X-Hub-Signature HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body; invalid or missing signatures are rejected.

config.name: Jira Webhook HMAC Signature
config.description: Inbound Jira webhook payloads are authenticated with an HMAC-SHA256 signature.

relationships.description: Orchestrator calls the external LLM provider for agent selection.

Orchestrator writes Jira issue embeddings to Qdrant during the RAG sync.
Orchestrator reads Jira issues over the Jira REST API to keep the RAG store in sync.
